name: fhe-application-design
description: Design and build Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) applications with OpenFHE (optional Niobium DSL path). An eleven-stage methodology (0-10) from build environment and privacy model through the faithful twin, encrypted implementation, protocol specification, and a simulation-validated Niobium Fog deployment — including empirically-grounded CKKS bootstrapping guidance and the fhe-boot-lab probe.
